headline: Lloyds Enterprises Limited acquires equity stake in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited
sum: Lloyds Enterprises Limited announced the acquisition of equity shares in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited, with the intimation filed on NSE on 19 June 2026.
detail: Lloyds Enterprises Limited, a listed entity on the National Stock Exchange, formally notified the exchange of its acquisition of equity shares in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited via intimation dated 19 June 2026. The NSE filing reference SGTL2008_19062026155550 confirms the corporate action disclosure. No acquisition value, consideration structure, or percentage stake has been disclosed in the available public record; further details regarding shareholding pattern, deal structure, and regulatory approvals remain pending in comprehensive filing or press release.
